scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names SERVER,CLIENT "npm run dev --workspace @amurland/server" "npm run dev --workspace @amurland/client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @amurland/shared && npm run build --workspace @amurland/server && npm run build --workspace @amurland/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @amurland/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @amurland/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @amurland/client
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @amurland/shared && npm run test --workspace @amurland/server
